observed_public_capabilities: searches YouTube content through the Musi interface
organizes YouTube videos as music-oriented playlists/favorites
does not provide downloading or caching as a supported feature
allowed_uses: confirm that an official/full-length YouTube representation is discoverable
support candidate discovery for later processing through authorized/public data paths
prohibited_as_evidence: treat Musi playback as an extractable full-song corpus source
mark a song FULL_TMT merely because it is playable in Musi
use Musi as a replacement for M_FULL, T_FULL or TEXT_FULL evidence
reason: Musi can reduce discovery friction because it exposes YouTube search/playback, but public information does not establish a research API or symbolic/full-song descriptor export. HookLab therefore keeps its full-song evidence gates unchanged.
future_adapter: If Musi exposes a documented authorized API/export later, reassess only the metadata/discovery interface first.
